release_notes:
BatchFox 1.0.3.13 (beta): what's new since 1.0.3.12
- Fixes a crash when archiving uncompressed Fuji X-Trans RAF files (X-T5, X-H2S, X100VI). These archives now finish and restore your original files byte for byte.
- Fixes lossless Nikon Z8 archives that could fail or hang. They now finish and restore your original files byte for byte.
- When an archive can't finish, BatchFox now tells you what happened in plain words, with what to try next.
- Export is rebuilt as a workflow: build it once, run it on every shoot, and pick the photos at run time. It adds undo, redo, and a step menu for building the flow.
- More tools now show live progress while they work, so a long job never looks frozen.
- BatchFox now uses only its own built-in helper tool, never a copy already on your computer.
